folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B294: approved work and engine-ready limits
folds.body:
The full 46-line checkpoint was reviewed, including the follow-up table and final corrected test result. The three initial save/wiring stop questions were subsequently approved and given commits here. Preserve the initial states as history; do not ask again whether those already selected follow-ups were authorized. The later heir snapshot, runtime trader argument and optional ledger are source additions, not necessarily actual UI or gameplay consumers. The record still says no game supplies worldSeed, no UI calls the predecessor-label helper and no consumer commits beatLedger. Those are dated consumer limits, not fresh present-code absence findings.

Headless PL-H1 day stepping, elder dialogue and re-derived beat equality do not prove verbs driving actual world beats, saved mid-window progression or a fresh-origin browser journey. Export/import of a ledger with no producer is distinct from meaningful persisted run continuation. Its rows were not in lead-run/1.3 shape and the named bystander smoke was unrun. The later 3,563-test green result follows the fixed validate-before-normalize issue; preserve the mid-edit failure and exact tested input rather than calling it independent failure or new passing evidence. Earlier suites overlap and include unrelated shared dirty files; generated build outputs were not committed with the lanes.

AD43 keeps source edit, focused/full tests, build, shown/used consumer and relevant persistence evidence distinct. All implemented-below-floor labels describe that checkpoint's incomplete proof, not an instruction to rebuild or declare today's whole lead system incomplete without its later owners. AD42 keeps human review separate and optional. Current lead developer build-through and ordinary/alternative-start scope retain their existing authority. No old lane, branch, commit, save decision or private reader is restarted by this review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B294: approval chronology and qualification scope
folds.body:
The complete 62-line plan was reviewed. Its opening records conditional October27 approval and a passed protocol-v2 gate; that later state supersedes the generic final yes-needed wording. Preserve the quoted old approval prompt as history, not a requirement to ask Weibao again. This content review grants no new source-reader dispatch or budget. Actual ongoing qualification resumes from its own current [reading status](READING_STATUS.md) and exact private checkpoint if that work is selected, rather than from these old 1–24/25–213 counts.

Keep the exact source scope: the specified Chinese first-volume edition and 213 chapter bodies, excluding the volume note, later volumes, sequel and adaptations. The original 63 remaining shards at up to three chapters fit the 189 remaining chapters; six ten-shard waves plus three is the same63, not a second reader count. Measured body characters, per-shard protocol tokens, retry estimates, stronger-model samples and excluded coordinator work measure different costs. The old concurrency/model/usage-window defaults and 110%-estimate stop rule do not describe today's live workers or allowance.

Per-shard lint and amount checks, one-in-three five-locator sampling, ten-percent row review, glossary rebuild and registry merge serve different validation roles. They do not independently prove every primary passage was read, correct every source conflict or qualify later whole-life coverage. A private output path, schema-shaped rows and a passed launch gate are not completed source reading or implemented protagonist play. Preserve source edition/cutoff and unresolved citation questions at their actual owner, keep sealed truth out of public outputs, and do not turn this bounded source plan into a default player start or new full-volume task.
